title: The Multilingual Alignment Prism: Aligning Global and Local Preferences to Reduce Harm
reasoning: The paper focuses on safety alignment and harm mitigation for LLMs, specifically benchmarking 'Discrimination & Injustice' which includes grounds of religion. It evaluates model responses to culturally sensitive prompts involving specific groups (e.g., Muslims, Dalits) and includes a section on culturally sensitive scenarios and moral dilemmas.
